subject: Dedicated reserved throughput & cost follow-up — GPU/profile questions
body:
From: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@acmepay.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Chu <ryan.chu@acmepay.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jun 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity sizing and costs

Thanks for the call this morning, Priyom — good to meet the Redwood team. A quick recap and a few clarifying Qs so my manager (Ryan) can approve a budget range.

Quick context: we expect ~120M inference tokens/month initially, spiking to ~500M over 6 months during promo windows. Typical prompt+response avg sequence length ~600 tokens. We need 95th percentile tail latency <250ms per request for chat flows.

Questions:
- Suggested reserved GPU type for that growth (A100 vs H100) and why?
- Rough target $/1M tokens you’d size us for (both reserved and burst) — we need ballpark to decide approval band.
- Minimum reservation you recommend to meet the latency SLOs and concurrency targets (we aim for 300 concurrent users at peak, ~5 requests/s per user during short bursts)

Thanks — attaching our draft SLO for reference. Can you send a short cost/throughput option set we can show leadership?

— Dana
Senior Product Manager, Acme Payments

----
From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@acmepay.com>
Cc: Ryan Chu <ryan.chu@acmepay.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity sizing and costs

Dana — great speaking with you both. Below is a concise options matrix (high-level) — I’ll loop in Marissa for precise numbers and a spreadsheet.

Summary of assumptions (please confirm):
- Monthly active tokens: baseline 120M, growth to 500M within 6 months.
- Avg sequence 600 tokens => estimate ~200k requests/day baseline.
- Target latency <=250ms p95 for chat (shorter for single-turn completions).

Option A — Cost-focused (starter reservation)
- GPU: 1x H100 per 2 replicas (quantized model) or A100 if H100 not available
- Reserved size: 4 GPUs initially (can autoscale burst to 6)
- Throughput estimate: ~20M tokens/day sustained across pool (~600k tokens/hr/gpu with batching/prefix cache)
- Ballpark unit economics: $X per 1M tokens (Marissa will fill)

Option B — Performance-first (latency headroom)
- GPU: H100 recommended for headroom and lower latency on long contexts
- Reserved size: 8 GPUs, burst to 12
- Throughput: ~45M tokens/day; p95 latency target comfortably met
- Higher reserved monthly commitment but lower per-token marginal cost

Action items: Marissa will produce an attached spreadsheet with explicit $/1M token estimates for reserved vs burst billing and call out amortized infra + support. Can we get confirmation on the concurrency pattern (sustained vs spiky) and whether compliance (SOC2) gating is required for procurement?

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

----
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@acmepay.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Jun 2025 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity sizing and costs

Dana / Priyom — attaching the sizing workbook (RI_Dedicated_Sizing_v2.xlsx). Key numbers from the sheet:

- Baseline (120M tokens/mo): Recommend Reserved = 4x H100 (quantized model profile) => estimated reserved cost band = $24k-$30k/mo; effective $/1M tokens = ~$200–$250 (reserved + support + infra amortized).
- Growth target (500M tokens/mo): Recommend Reserved = 12x H100 with autoscaling burst to 16 => estimated reserved cost band = $66k-$75k/mo; effective $/1M tokens = ~$120–$150.

Notes & assumptions:
- Sequence length 600 tokens avg; batching and prefix caching materially reduce per-token CPU/GPU time for repeated prompts.
- A100 option reduces reserved pricing ~5–8% but may increase p95 tail latency by ~30–60ms at high seq lengths. H100 gives better headroom for your concurrency pattern.
- Burst pricing model used for excess tokens beyond reservation and for extra GPUs during promo spikes. We provide a separate burst rate (higher $/1M).

Procurement notes: we can include a SOC2 attestation as part of Private/Dedicated onboarding; for hosted plans we have existing reports. Let us know which compliance artifacts you need.

Next steps suggested:
1) Choose GPU preference (H100 recommended) and confirm target reservation band (starter vs growth).
2) Sign NDA + draft SLA (SLA_Draft_Acme.pdf attached) to unblock procurement.
3) Schedule sizing review with engineering (30–45m) to validate traffic patterns and eviction/kv-cache behavior.

I’ll flag the detailed per-token calc cells in the sheet.

— Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

----
From: Ryan Chu <ryan.chu@acmepay.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@acmepay.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 08:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity sizing and costs

Thanks — this is helpful. A few clarifications from finance:
- Budget band we can approve initially: up to $50k/mo committed for Q3. Anything above needs VP approval.
- Our risk tolerance for latency tail is medium — 250ms p95 acceptable but prefer headroom for promos.

Questions:
1) For the $50k/mo committed cap, which reserved configuration gets us closest to 300 concurrent peak with p95 ~250ms?
2) What's the delta if we pick A100 to hit $50k vs H100?

We can attach the PO to a 6-month reserved term once we align on config.

— Ryan
Director of Product, Acme Payments

----
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ryan Chu <ryan.chu@acmepay.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@acmepay.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity sizing and costs

Ryan — quick reply to your two Qs:

1) $50k/mo committed: our recommended near-fit is 6x A100 reserved (quantized profile) with burst to 8 A100 for promo spikes. That config is tuned to hit ~300 concurrent users with p95 close to 250ms after batching/caching.

2) Delta A100 vs H100 for that band:
- 6x A100 reserved effective $/1M tokens ~= $170–$190 (depends on token split reserved vs burst).
- Same capacity on H100 (6x) would give ~15–20% better latency headroom but would push committed cost above $50k (closer to $58k/mo).

Recommendation: if leadership can accept the potential small tail risk, start with 6x A100 reserved to fit the $50k budget, include a 90-day review clause to move to H100 or scale to 8–12 GPUs as traffic ramps. We can bake that into the mutual action plan/PO.

Action: Prio items for us to prepare before PO — updated sheet with the 6x A100 plan (per-token calc), a one-page mutual action plan, and a draft PO template for your procurement team.

I’ll upload the 6x-A100 tab to the Drive link and send a short slide for the VP.

— Ben
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

> Dana
